+def test_quoted_comma_in_first_field(tmp_path):
+    # Regression: a comma inside the FIRST quoted field must not split the row.
+    path = write_csv(tmp_path, 'city,motto\n"Springfield, IL",Capital\n')
+    summary = summarize(read_csv(path))
+    assert summary["total_columns"] == 2
+    assert summary["first_data_row"] == ["Springfield, IL", "Capital"]
+
+
+def test_quoted_comma_in_last_field(tmp_path):
+    # Regression: a comma inside the LAST quoted field must not add a column.
+    path = write_csv(tmp_path, 'city,motto\nPortland,"City of Roses, Bridges"\n')
+    summary = summarize(read_csv(path))
+    assert summary["total_columns"] == 2
+    assert summary["first_data_row"] == ["Portland", "City of Roses, Bridges"]
+
+
+def test_multiple_quoted_commas_in_one_row(tmp_path):
+    # Regression: several quoted fields containing commas in the same row.
+    path = write_csv(tmp_path, 'a,b,c\n"x,1","y,2","z,3"\n')
+    summary = summarize(read_csv(path))
+    assert summary["total_columns"] == 3
+    assert summary["first_data_row"] == ["x,1", "y,2", "z,3"]
+
+
